steps.content: The monsters instantly overwhelmed the fallen one.
The soaring M-value has transformed all the greedy, brutal thugs into Corruptors. Their avarice is on display for all to see.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: How hopelessly ignorant...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: In the face of truth, falsehood, and your so-called responsibility...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: ...You end up choosing death.
Stargazer jumped down from the ruins and coldly watched the incoming Corruptors howl as they besiege their prey.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The prophesying game always exposes the ugly desires and feared truths of humans.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I should've gotten used to it by now.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It's a pity that, in the end, you cannot be my...
Stargazer turned away. Her face filled with disappointment, as if she has seen a half-eaten apple.
She waved her hand and cast her power to exacerbate the monsters' cravings, like giving her little monster a funeral in her own way.
But just as she left, gunshots rang out from the pile of monsters behind her.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: What...?
Stargazer froze for a bit, and she turned around to see a gap in the encirclement, broken through by a single pistol.
From that small, dark gap, a strong force shot through and bound Stargazer with fearsome strength.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It's... the shackles...!
Stargazer could feel her own power frozen as the thorn-like force pierced her wrists and neck.
The caster of this force is standing amidst the seething monsters.
He is riddled with wounds, and the pitch-black liquid seeping into his eyes obscures his vision. Yet he stands tall without flinching, and says to Stargazer—
steps.female_content: She is riddled with wounds, and the pitch-black liquid seeping into her eyes obscures her vision. Yet she stands tall without flinching, and says to Stargazer—

options: Protect me. Don't let me die.

choices.text: Protect me. Don't let me die.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You used your shackles...? Aren't you afraid...!
Sinners cannot disobey orders from the shackles. Stargazer's hand twitched gently and began to attack the Corruptors around you.
Of course I'm not afraid...
You gaze towards the pitch-black DisSea, where shapeless screams are beckoning you to come.

I shall be the one to decide who takes part in my destiny, when and how they take part, and where my grave shall be... I know at least that I won't be there just yet. My shackles and Sinners... are my strongest weapons.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Hahaha... In that case, I can only... obey your command.
You brandish your pistol, slaying the frenzied monsters alongside Stargazer.
Though without Stargazer's exacerbating power, the thugs were desperados to begin with, and they've only grown more violent after mutating into Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: There are people like these everywhere in this world.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No one can guarantee that they won't become such a monster after exposing their innermost desires.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Your so-called protection is also shielding them.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Without shackles or Sinners, you'd die from their bites.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Are you still going to persist even if the truth is so ugly?
Stargazer's expression changed slightly upon hearing your answer.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Oh? You finally had an epiphany after a visit to the gates of hell?
You turned and pointed your gun at Stargazer. Locking your gaze onto hers, you pulled the trigger. The bullet grazed her hood and hit the Corruptor sneaking up behind her square in the forehead.
I will not shield them.
Stargazer uses her power to restrain the monsters who are still writhing forward despite having their hands and feet pierced by you. She then motioned for you to continue speaking.
You walk over to the restrained Corruptor with your gun raised, shut your eyes and fire into its vital organs.
The crisis is resolved as the last Corruptor is wiped out. Calm finally returns to the chaotic Broken Frontline. You gaze at the once again tranquil DisSea as you speak to Stargazer.
Like I said, I'm well aware that this path is filled with danger, and that at its end is the end of everything.
This world is filled with crises, but I'm already an integral part of it.
Stargazer's crystal ball began to spin, but there's no longer dark mist swirling inside.
Like grains of sand from WhiteSands, the pure white particles gathered little by little, emitting a faint glow.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: What are you thinking about?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You're clearly able to repudiate all arrangements given to you, then why do you still linger in this world?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You're someone who can reach the truth. I've been hardly able to find any companion in this world, except for you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Thus, even if you awaken to a chaotic haze, and your body is but a false shell, I still wish to go with you.
Stargazer watched you shoot all the Corruptors she restrained. After you wiped out all the Corruptors, she came forward to gently wipe the stains off your face.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Little monster... you are both an executor and a guardian.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Both a pioneer and a nostalgic.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Who... are you exactly?
I don't know.
But perhaps that's why I accepted this arrangement and destiny.
I shall explore this world as an executor, a guardian, a pioneer, and a nostalgic.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Even if this world is false?
Even if this world is false.
You say that my body is but a false shell, that you can't see my soul, and that endless darkness lies beneath my eyes.
Then can I assume, after all the lies and suffering I've encountered are devoured, drowned out, and broken down by this abyssal body...
...A soul of my own will then be born?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: A soul will be born?
A twisted expression dawned on Stargazer's face, as if she had just witnessed something incredible.
You shrug and look around, spotting your tattered, blood-soaked jacket.
You walk over and take out something from the inner pocket—Stargazer's final tarot card that represents death. Yet behind that card, you find another one...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Still think you've won?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Even if you've bound me with your shackles now, in essence, you did not overturn my prophecy.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You will still...
I won.
I won, Anarkia. I overturned your prophecy.
You say the name softly and smile at Stargazer's stunned expression.
You show her what you just took out—the star card that is stained red alongside your bloodied clothes.
It is the card that Stargazer had used to declare your destiny at the ruins.
But when you flip over the star card, the image of the scythe-wielding Grim Reaper wailing on the oak barrel has turned into a shining nova, blasting in the middle of the card.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: It ended up here... How amazing.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: Incredible, my little monster... You changed the star card?
I do have the power of "change," but I didn't change the star card.
You point to the star card. Etched above Anarkia's name in beautiful, cursive font is a simple, powerful word: Hope.
What I have is the power to change destiny.
At least I hope I can change my own destiny.
Stargazer, or Anarkia, took the star card from your hand, examined it for a second, and then burst out laughing.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: Hahahahaha!

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: Well played! Overturning my prophecy, changing destiny!

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: Alas, I am so curious...!

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: You always manage to surprise me, little monster!
Anarkia glided over and gazed into your eyes. She scooped up your hands and pressed them against her bosom.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: You've won this game, little monster. The victory is yours.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: I saw through this world and found the Realm of Truth. You discovered my real name and you're determined to change your destiny.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: You and I are two of a kind. We are the same, little monster!
You can feel with your palms that Anarkia's heart is beating very, very fast.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: I've decided to stay by your side, little monster...

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: Keep on using me like you did today, my honorable Chief.
You... are willing to compromise?

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: Oh no... of course not.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: I'm just too curious!

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: When a false body gives birth to a real soul, what will be its ultimate fate?
I never understood why you think my existence is a false one.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: You can safely assume that everyone born into this world is a false existence.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: The flesh, blood, skin, and thoughts of humans are all one mask upon another, used to create a facade of truth.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: But those are all smoke and mirrors to me, little monster. I can see through them all. Otherwise, how could I've controlled and exposed their hearts so effortlessly?

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: But you... You're different...
Anarkia's robe flutters gracefully in the wind, like the first time you saw her dance under the moon in WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: You accept the falsehood of your existence, yet still strive to seek the truth...

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: Dragging along your false shell of a body, you seek your true soul...

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: I must thank the Dreamflower for helping me find you... Hahahaha!

steps.speaker: Anarkia
steps.content: Let me tag along by your side. I want to witness... the moment when you find the truth of this world.
